# Moodle TalTech

> TalTech's Moodle learning management system providing secure access to educational resources through multiple Estonian digital authentication methods.

Moodle TalTech is the primary learning platform for Tallinn University of Technology students and staff, supporting various authentication mechanisms including Uni-ID, ID-card, Mobile-ID, and Smart-ID. The platform serves as the central hub for course management, content delivery, and academic collaboration.

## Key Topics

- Moodle
- Learning Management System
- TalTech
- Authentication Methods
- Uni-ID
- ID-kaart (ID-card)
- Mobiil-ID (Mobile-ID)
- Smart-ID
- Token Signing
- pass.ttu.ee
- Digital Identity
- Estonia
- e-Government

## Authentication & Access

- [Moodle Login Portal](https://moodle.taltech.ee): TalTech Moodle learning management system login page with multiple authentication methods including Uni-ID, ID-kaart, Mobiil-ID, and Smart-ID.
